blocks.heading: Type it once
blocks.body:
Last week the booklet was a table of contents. This week it also holds **names**.

You have two pages that mention the shop’s product. If you type “Kitepump KP-2” in both, a rename will miss a page. Put the name in the booklet. Point at it from the pages.

Open `kitepump.ditamap`. Set it as the **root map** :  the main booklet Oxygen should use. Then change the stored name. Both pages should follow.

blocks.heading: If the name looks broken
blocks.body: Unset the root map on purpose. The pages cannot see the name. Set it again. That is the whole trick.

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
You just met the idea. Now do the lab: Change the name once.

This lab can fail. Fail when: You typed the product string on both pages, or you left the root map unset, or only one page uses the name from the booklet.

Expected: The booklet holds Kitepump KP-2a. Two pages show it. Completeness is clean with the root map set.

blocks.lead: Walk the cards below, in order, to Change the name once.
blocks.intro: How to Change the name once. Walk the cards in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Change the name once
steps.body: This is the whole move. The next cards are the steps, in order.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Open samples/kitepump-dita/kitepump.ditamap. Set it as the root map (the main booklet).

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Find the product name in the booklet. The sample already has a name (Kitepump KP-2) stored once. If you cannot see it in the tree, open the booklet in Text and look for keys="product".

image.alt: Default Oxygen XML Editor window with menus, side views, and the empty editor in the middle
image.caption: The first Oxygen window. Menus at the top, helper views at the sides, empty editor in the middle.
image.credit: Oxygen XML Editor User Guide, Syncro Soft

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Open what-is-kitepump.dita and prime-the-pump.dita. Each page should use that name, not a typed copy of Kitepump KP-2. If a sentence still types the name, replace that bit with a keyword that points at the name in the booklet.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: In the booklet, change the stored name to Kitepump KP-2a. Both pages should show KP-2a in Author.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Unset the root map. The name on the pages should look broken or empty. Set the root map again.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Run completeness. Fix any broken name you caused.

blocks.summary: The booklet holds Kitepump KP-2a. Two pages show it. Completeness is clean with the root map set.

blocks.body: The lab is done. Prove it with the check. Use words from today only.

blocks.q: The product name looks broken in Author. First place you look?
options: Whether the root map is set
blocks.why: Names in the booklet only work when that booklet is the root map.

blocks.lead: Answer with words from today only.
blocks.q: Why put the product name in the booklet instead of typing it on every page?
options: You change it once and every page that uses the name follows
Typing is the only way a title works
blocks.why: One name in the booklet is one edit. Forty typed copies are forty misses.
